title: Host configuration
description: Schema for the host settings file read and written only by .claude/scripts/config/config.mjs: ~/.config/maxwell/config.json by default, or the path in MAXWELL_CONFIG_FILE. It lives outside the workspace. It holds model choices, paths and the names of environment variables that carry secrets, never a secret value. An environment variable named for a setting wins over the file, so a hosted harness can seed or override every setting without writing it

settings.description: Current values by setting key. Keys are closed: config.mjs refuses any key not listed here

models.default.description: Model run-headless.mjs asks Claude Code for when --model is not given (environment MAXWELL_MODEL)

models.fallback.description: Model Claude Code retries on after a usage limit or overload (environment MAXWELL_FALLBACK_MODEL)

models.map.opus.description: Provider model the opus alias runs on, for agents that pin model: opus (environment ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL)

models.map.sonnet.description: Provider model the sonnet alias runs on, for agents that pin model: sonnet (environment ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL)

models.map.haiku.description: Provider model the haiku alias runs on, for agents that pin model: haiku (environment ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL)

pricing.file.description: Absolute path to an extra price table (same shape as vocab/pricing) whose entries override or extend the built-in one, for provider list prices (environment MAXWELL_PRICING_FILE)

executor.file.description: Absolute path to an executor document (company/executor schema) used instead of company-profile/<company_id>/sdlc/executor.json; its companyId must match the company being run (environment MAXWELL_EXECUTOR_FILE)

sandbox.credentialsDir.description: Absolute path of the directory holding sandbox provider credential files, outside the workspace (environment MAXWELL_SANDBOX_CREDENTIALS_DIR)

complianceos.credentialsFile.description: Absolute path of the ComplianceOS login file written by cos/search.mjs set-credentials, outside the workspace (environment MAXWELL_COS_CREDENTIALS_FILE)

complianceos.emailRef.description: Name of the environment variable that holds the ComplianceOS login email

complianceos.passwordRef.description: Name of the environment variable that holds the ComplianceOS password

complianceos.tokenRef.description: Name of the environment variable that holds a ComplianceOS bearer token

updated.description: When and by whom each setting was last set, by setting key

envName.description: An environment variable name; the value itself is read from the environment at run time and never stored
